title: A Big Day for Image Generation and Touch-Sensing Robots

opening.say: This is Mono Radio. Good morning, it's Friday, November sixth.
opening.show: This is Mono Radio. Good morning, it's Friday, November 6.

opening.say: We've got five stories for you today.
opening.show: We've got five stories for you today.

news.label: Images 2.6 Released
points: Adds GIF creation and SVG export
details: Image generation is now 50 percent faster than before. The fastest time of six seconds is the maker's own figure, using Flare at its low quality setting.
You can create animated GIFs from still images or sketches, and markup editing on images and SVG export have been added.
In the API, you can choose Flare for speed or Sunburst for quality.

lines.say: First up, OpenAI's new image generator, Images two point six.
lines.show: First up, OpenAI's new image generator, Images 2.6.

lines.say: Generation is fifty percent faster, and it now supports animated GIFs and S V G output too.
lines.show: Generation is 50% faster, and it now supports GIF and SVG output.

lines.say: That's a lot more room for creativity.
lines.show: That's a lot more room for creativity.

link.title: ChatGPT Images 2.6 adds GIFs, SVGs and speed
link.description: OpenAI adds animated GIFs and saved reference images to ChatGPT. Images 2.6 is also faster and enables more precise image editing.

news.label: Touch-Sensing Robot AI: T-Rex
details: The team added touch data from ten fingertips to a vision-language-action model.
The overall motion runs at about 5 hertz, while fine corrections based on touch run at about 20 hertz.
Across 12 kinds of tasks, such as moving eggs and unlocking locks, it averaged 65 percent success, versus 35 percent for the comparison model. These are the research team's own evaluations.

lines.say: Next, from Japan, a robotics project called T-Rex, from Panasonic and others.
lines.show: Next, from Japan, a robotics project called T-Rex, from Panasonic and others.

lines.say: Using the sense of touch in its fingertips, it handles delicate tasks like moving eggs from one place to another.
lines.show: Using fingertip touch, it handles delicate tasks like moving eggs.

lines.say: What's neat is that it separates big movements from quick corrections.
lines.show: What's neat is that it separates big movements from quick corrections.

news.label: Hacadly AI Agent
details: It can create STEP files from 2D drawings in DXF or vector PDF format.
From 3D data that has no history, it reconstructs a history of sketches, extrusions, holes, and more.
In the company's own tests, it successfully reproduced the shapes in all 23 2D drawings. That's a small in-house benchmark, not a general guarantee of accuracy.

lines.say: Now a story about design: the Hacadly AI agent from WOGO.
lines.show: Now a story about design: the Hacadly AI agent from WOGO.

lines.say: It rebuilds editable C A D data from two D drawings.
lines.show: It rebuilds editable CAD data from 2D drawings.

lines.say: The key point is that you can change the dimensions, not just look at the shape.
lines.show: The key point is that you can change the dimensions.

news.label: Single Crystals in Metal 3D Printing
details: Researchers built a single crystal of Ti-6Al-4V about one meter tall and centimeters across.
The method is wire arc additive manufacturing with heat input that alternates back and forth.
By reducing grain boundaries, it may improve creep resistance at high temperatures. This is still at the research stage.

lines.say: And from overseas, some metal three D printing research.
lines.show: And from overseas, some metal 3D printing research.

lines.say: Using a method published in Nature, researchers built a single crystal structure about one meter tall.
lines.show: Using a method published in Nature, they built a single crystal about 1m tall.

lines.say: So it controls not just the shape, but the crystals inside as well.
lines.show: It controls not just the shape, but the crystals inside.

news.label: Expelled from Paradise Mecha Transformation
details: It started as a transformation spread over several cuts, but was changed to a continuous camera move of about 16 seconds.
Animators duplicated parts and added hinges, spikes, and inner mechanisms.
In the sphere transformation scene, they switch between a humanoid model and a sphere model to keep the motion natural.

lines.say: It walks through how the sixteen second single take mecha transformation in Expelled from Paradise was made.
lines.show: It walks through making the 16-second single-take mecha transformation in Expelled from Paradise.

lines.say: Prioritizing the visible angles is a smart tradeoff worth learning from.
lines.show: Prioritizing visible angles is a smart tradeoff.
